title: Self-Supervised Tuning of Low-Fidelity Optimization Models via High-Fidelity Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2610.28851v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Low-fidelity (LF) optimization models are widely used in large-scale operations because they can be solved efficiently and reliably, but they often exhibit systematic errors relative to high-fidelity (HF) formulations that better capture physical and operational constraints. Existing learning-based approaches typically rely on supervised or semi-supervised training with HF solutions, which are expensive to compute and may not align with HF operational objectives. We propose a self-supervised framework that parameterizes LF optimization models directly from HF feedback. The low-fidelity problem is embedded as a differentiable optimization layer and trained end-to-end, while a HF correction problem evaluates its solution and provides gradient information through its dual variables, without requiring HF solution labels. translated_title: 基于高保真反馈的低保真优化模型自监督调优
translated_abstract: 低保真（LF）优化模型因求解高效可靠而被广泛应用于大规模运营场景，但相对于能更好刻画物理与运行约束的高保真（HF）模型，它们往往存在系统性误差。现有的基于学习的方法通常依赖使用高保真解的监督或半监督训练，然而高保真解的计算成本高昂，且可能与高保真运行目标不一致。我们提出一种自监督框架，直接依据高保真反馈对低保真优化模型进行参数化。该框架将低保真问题嵌入为一个可微分优化层并进行端到端训练，同时由一个高保真校正问题评估其解，并通过对偶变量提供梯度信息，而无需高保真解标签。我们在最优潮流、最优天然气流和池化问题上对该框架进行了评估，涵盖了不同来源的不确定性。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种自监督框架，将低保真优化模型嵌入为可微分优化层，借助高保真校正问题对偶变量提供的梯度进行端到端训练，无需昂贵的高保真解标签即可自动修正低保真模型在最优潮流、最优气流和池化等问题中的系统性误差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a self-supervised framework that embeds low-fidelity optimization models as differentiable layers and tunes them end-to-end using gradient feedback from a high-fidelity correction problem's dual variables, eliminating the need for expensive high-fidelity solution labels while correcting systematic errors in optimal power flow, optimal gas flow, and pooling problems.
